stage: Stage B: Live Traffic / Low Conversion

tier_1_permanent_laws.rule: Left (.grader-card) and Right (.results-panel) columns in #analyzer must maintain 0px dead bottom white-space gap and match outer/inner heights (~720px-750px) so the entire workbench fits comfortably on a single laptop screen.

Never stack the AM/PM schedule cards AND the full Clash breakdown cards simultaneously on initial load. Enforce a strict mutually-exclusive 3-Tab Stage (1. AM & PM Order | 2. Why Clashed | 3. 4-Night & Card) with One-In, One-Out DOM complexity.

100% everyday women's beauty English (Sephora/Glossier/Rhode tone). Strictly ban developer, B2B, actuarial, or raw chemistry jargon (Sunk-Cost, Bioavailability, Culprit Autopsy, Perioral Sting, Nasolabial, Micro-Fissures, PAO Oxidation, Bos & Meinardi, Ester Hydrolysis, Stratum Corneum, Transepidermal, TEWL, Equilibration, pKa, Daltons, Unsaved Tab Session).
Never auto-pop the 5-Slot Vanity Bag drawer or any modal on initial page load. Drawers and modals open strictly on explicit user click.

On /compare/* pages, only label a cheaper bottle a 'Dupe' when both bottles belong to the same category/step (sameCat === true). Cross-category pairs must be framed as 'Can You Layer Them Together? (AM & PM Guide)'.
Every file in src/*.js must stay strictly < 1,000 lines and pass node test/verify.js (Playwright desktop 1440x900 + mobile 390x844).

tier_2_contextual_hypotheses.node: Node 3 & Node 4A (Free Cannibalization Gate + 1-Field Email Save Bridge)
tier_2_contextual_hypotheses.hypothesis: Adding a 1-field 'Email My 4-Night Calendar & Lock-Screen Pass (Free)' bridge directly inside the Tab 1 summary card (replacing duplicate tab buttons under One-In, One-Out) while gating the Night 3-4 exact recovery rotation behind Email/Kit unlock will lift Engage-to-Lead from 0% to >=12% without increasing column height.

tier_2_contextual_hypotheses.node: Node 5 (Zero Price Shock in Checkout Modal)
tier_2_contextual_hypotheses.hypothesis: Aligning #checkoutModal radio options with the $1.99 button label ($1.99 Single Routine Kit vs. $4.99 Unlimited Multi-Shelf Pass) removes the $1.99 -> $4.99 price shock.
A 1-tap inline micro-poll ('Missing a bottle? [Request Bottle] [Want Cheaper Dupes] [Just Browsing]') logged to telemetry captures real shopper objections.

sprint_history.focus: Calm 737px Single-View Tab Stage & 50% Lower Cognitive Density
sprint_history.outcome: UX & symmetry solved (737px === 737px), but Node 4A (Lead Capture = 0) and Node 5 ($1.99 vs $4.99 modal price shock) remained unaddressed.
